response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is primarily in TypeScript/Node.js, which raises concerns about his readiness for the core C++-centric responsibilities of the role.
strengths: Proven experience building geospatial platforms (GISCollective) with real-world usage by NGOs.
Strong track record in distributed systems, low-latency services, and DevOps infrastructure.
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks and domains.
concerns: No explicit C++ or Rust experience in commercial routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines.
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/Node.js, with minimal evidence of modern C++ system development.
Lacks clear evidence of fault tolerance, consistency, or distributed systems work in routing contexts.
